notes: The editor glosses between dashes («قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا», «واللفظ، لابن المثنى») are left out.

«حدثني أبي» is a bare relation of Mu'adh, not identified. Umar's words «سمعت رسول الله» make him the last link, as in the Uthman pattern of rule 6; the Muslim who came from Yemen and the Kufa exchange are scene.
